_baseBranch: This repo is single-branch: main is both the base AND production. There is no develop to absorb a mistake, so nothing here should be read as being as safe as the same setting in a repo with a staging branch.
_reviewLabel: No ai-review reviewer is wired for this repo yet. TRUE deliberately: with no reviewer, pr:land does every step up to the merge and then exits 30 for a human. Setting it false would auto-merge straight to production on CI alone — and here that IS production, with no intermediate branch. No change needed once a reviewer starts posting.
_reviewTimeoutMs: Short until a reviewer exists — no point idling for a review that cannot arrive.
_ciPaths: check.yml has an unqualified `pull_request:` trigger and no paths: filter, so every PR runs it.
_hardStop: This repo enforces its architecture invariants through scripts/check-*.mjs, listed in AGENTS.md's 'Every invariant is enforced' table. Weakening a checker is how an invariant dies quietly, so those files never self-merge even when the checker they gut still passes. There are no Firestore/Storage rules files in this repo today; add them here the moment there are.

hardStop.why: proves each checker flags a real violation
